in_marathi.name: Nidrita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nidrita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidra' meaning 'sleep'. In Hindu mythology, 'Nidra' is personified as the goddess of sleep and dreams.
